title: Customer Fit Orbit Matrix
body:
Purpose: a compact, action-oriented segmentation sheet to drive QBR agenda decisions and renewal priority triage. This sheet combines ICP fit, deployment-mode alignment, region exposure, and contract signal into a single prioritized list with recommended playbook moves.

Usage guidance:
- Run this during QBR prep: update the four signal columns (ICP_Fit, Deploy_Match, Region_Risk, Contract_Stage) then review the computed Priority_Score and the suggested Playbook_Action.
- Priority_Score = round(ICP_Fit*0.40 + Deploy_Match*0.25 + (100 - Region_Risk)*0.15 + Contract_Stage*0.20). All input fields are 0-100.
- Bands: 80-100 = High (Immediate action), 60-79 = Medium (Schedule playbook), <60 = Low (monitor).
- Quick color legend: High=Green, Medium=Amber, Low=Red.

Columns:
Account | ICP_Fit | Deploy_Match | Region_Risk | Contract_Stage | Priority_Score | Band | Owner | Suggested_Playbook_Action | Next_30d_Milestone | Notes

-- sample rows --
SkylineRetail | 85 | 90 | 30 | 70 | 84 | High | Diego Marquez | Dedicated pilot + cost review + canary SLA | Schedule pilot kickoff (wk1) | Strong ICP fit; retail ML team wants on-prem for PII. Add solutions eng to kickoff.
NovaDocs | 60 | 40 | 45 | 50 | 53 | Low | Priya Shah | Retention playbook: model pruning + infra savings pilot | Confirm monthly usage baseline | Medium ICP fit; mismatched deployment (hosted vs wanted private). Risk: procurement delay.
PaxHealth | 92 | 75 | 80 | 90 | 84 | High | Omar Khurana | Private deployment + compliance onboarding + KMS integration checklist | Compliance scoping call (wk1) | High contract maturity; region risk high (APAC regulator) -> prioritized legal loop.
BrightSignals | 45 | 70 | 20 | 40 | 53 | Low | Maya Lin | Upsell playbook: map features -> cost/value, executive intro | Invite for feature showcase (wk2) | Low ICP fit; deploy match ok but contract stage early.
AtlasAnalytics | 78 | 65 | 35 | 60 | 70 | Medium | Diego Marquez | Optimize playbook: batching/quantization recommendations + dedicated sizing | Provide cost-savings proposal (wk1) | Good fit for Dedicated; show unit-econ examples.
MercuryBank | 88 | 95 | 25 | 80 | 87 | High | Priya Shah | Enterprise SLA + rollout canary + SRE onboarding | SLA draft + canary plan (wk1) | Bank requires high reliability; top priority for Dedicated reserved capacity.
EchoLogistics | 66 | 55 | 50 | 55 | 60 | Medium | Omar Khurana | Migration playbook: hybrid routing + regional fallback | Confirm routing policy (wk2) | Deployment mismatch: wants hybrid (some on-prem, some hosted).
PraxisMedia | 50 | 35 | 15 | 30 | 41 | Low | Maya Lin | Cost-reduction playbook + usage training | Training session (wk3) | Low contract progress; usage declining.

Scoring examples explained:
- ICP_Fit (0-100): composite of product fit signals (feature usage, domain match, LTV proxy). 0 = no fit, 100 = textbook ICP.
- Deploy_Match (0-100): how closely current deployment maps to recommended deployment mode for workload (hosted/dedicated/private). 100 = perfect map.
- Region_Risk (0-100): regulatory/latency exposure where higher numbers mean more risk (higher risk reduces score). Use 100 for unsalvageable regulatory blockers.
- Contract_Stage (0-100): opposable commercial signal (0 = MQL/no contract, 100 = signed multi-year commitment).

Operational playbook snippets (short):
- Dedicated pilot: propose 3-week reserved pool proof-of-concept, provide latency/cost baseline, commit engineering support hours.
- Private deployment: compliance intake, KMS/HSM plan, network runbook, and on-prem packaging checklist.
- Optimize playbook: batching, KV cache tuning, quantization profile recommendation and simulated cost delta.
- Migration/hybrid: routing policy config, fallback model mapping, canary rollout gates.
- Retention/cost playbook: usage review, credits, product training, negotiate contract cadence.

QBR facilitation tips:
- Start with High band accounts: confirm top 3 action owners and specific dates for pilot/onboarding artifacts.
- For Medium band accounts, pick 1-2 to move to High within the quarter through targeted technical or commercial interventions.
- Low band: set monthly monitoring triggers; only escalate if usage or contract signals change.

Appendix – quick lookup sheet:
- Suggested outreach sequence per band: High = CSM + Solutions Eng + Sales (wk0), Medium = CSM + Product (wk1), Low = CSM only (monthly).
- Example Jira keys for common workflows: Dedicated pilot template CS-1201, Private compliance intake CS-1305, Optimize suggestions CS-1402.

End of sheet.
